kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-instances --project-env PROD --node-id 100000000000 --node-name openmr_80000 --owner 1933790000 --project-id 12345 --biz-name test_bizName --program-type ODPS_SQL --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --dag-id 11111 --bizdate 2020-02-02_00:00:00 --begin-bizdate 2020-02-02_00:00:00 --end-bizdate 2020-02-03_00:00:00 --status NOT_RUN --order-by INSTANCE_ID_DESC --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListInstances

parameters.help_en:
The runtime environment. Valid values:

PROD: production environment.
DEV: development environment
parameters.help_zh: 运行的环境，包括PROD（生产环境）和DEV（开发环境）
parameters.name: project_env

parameters.help_en: The node ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173979.html to query the node ID
parameters.help_zh: 节点的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173979.html查看节点ID信息
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The node name. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173979.html to query the node name
parameters.help_zh: 节点的名称。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173979.html查看节点名称
parameters.name: node_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the owner, which is the UID of the workspace administrator. You can logon to the Alibaba Cloud Management Console and view the UID in the Security Settings section of the storage management page
parameters.help_zh: 负责人的ID，即工作空间管理员的账号UID。您可登录阿里云控制台后，在账号管理的安全管理中查看账号UID
parameters.name: owner

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178393.html to query the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178393.html查看空间ID信息
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the workflow. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173945.html to query workflow information
parameters.help_zh: 业务流程的名称。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173945.html查看业务流程信息
parameters.name: biz_name

parameters.help_en: The node type. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173979.html to query the node type
parameters.help_zh: 节点的类型。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173979.html查看节点类型
parameters.name: program_type

parameters.help_en: The page number. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 页码数，用于翻页。最小值为1，最大值为100
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大100条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The DAG ID. The DagId can be the DagId returned by operations such as https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212961.html for data backfill, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212949.html for smoke testing, and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212830.html for manual workflows
parameters.help_zh: DagId可以是执行补数据https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212961.html，冒烟测试https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212949.html，手动业务流程https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212830.html等接口返回的DagId
parameters.name: dag_id

parameters.help_en: The date for which to retrieve the instance list. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh: 获取实例列表的日期，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: bizdate

parameters.help_en: The start date for which to retrieve the instance list. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh: 获取实例列表的开始日期，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: begin_bizdate

parameters.help_en: The end date for which to retrieve the instance list. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh: 获取实例列表的结束日期，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: end_bizdate

parameters.help_en:
The status of the node. Valid values:

NOT_RUN: The node is not run.

WAIT_TIME: The node is waiting for the scheduled time (DueTime or CycTime) to arrive.

WAIT_RESOURCE: The node is waiting for resources.

RUNNING: The node is running.
CHECKING: The node has been sent to Data Quality for data validation.
CHECKING_CONDITION: The node is undergoing branch condition verification.
FAILURE: Failed to execute.
SUCCESS: Execute successfully
parameters.help_zh:
任务的状态，取值如下：

NOT_RUN（未运行）

WAIT_TIME（等待定时间DueTime或CycTime到来）

WAIT_RESOURCE（等待资源）

RUNNING（运行中）
CHECKING（下发给数据质量进行数据校验）
CHECKING_CONDITION（正在进行分支条件校验）
FAILURE（执行失败）
SUCCESS（执行成功）
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The sorting rule for the returned results. Valid values:
CREATE_TIME_DESC: sorted by creation time in descending order.
INSTANCE_ID_DESC: default value. Sorted by instance ID in descending order
parameters.help_zh:
返回值的排序规则。取值如下：
CREATE_TIME_DESC：按照创建时间降序返回
INSTANCE_ID_DESC：默认值，按照实例ID降序返回。
parameters.name: order_by
